title: Semiparametric inference on identification sets in choice modeling
summary: In a discrete choice model, choice probabilities observed for a finite collection of choice sets may not identify a counterfactual choice probability under an unobserved choice set. We represent this counterfactual probability as a linear functional of a mixing distribution. Because the target is a functional of a distribution whose support is not restricted to a finite set, the parameter space is infinite-dimensional, while the data impose only finitely many moment restrictions.
